title: Measure Before You Manage: Evaluating Agent Working Memory in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.31057v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent working memory is heterogeneous. Objects such as instructions, artifacts, tool outputs, and agent-generated state play different semantic roles and exhibit different size, retention, and representation profiles. Recent work has begun to explore memory-management mechanisms that account for such heterogeneity. This work focuses on semantic heterogeneity and studies how it should shape the management and evaluation of working memory in coding agents. Across 55 archived coding-agent trajectories, we find that semantically different working-memory objects exhibit distinct retention and compression behavior. This heterogeneity motivates semantically informed memory management. We study two semantically informed strategies: an object-aware compression policy and a retrieval-based policy. translated_title: 先测量后管理：评估编码智能体中的智能体工作记忆
translated_abstract: 智能体工作记忆是异构的。诸如指令、工件、工具输出和智能体生成的状态等对象扮演着不同的语义角色，并表现出不同的大小、保留和表示特征。最近的工作已开始探索考虑这种异构性的记忆管理机制。本工作聚焦于语义异构性，研究它应如何塑造编码智能体中工作记忆的管理与评估。通过对55个存档的编码智能体轨迹的分析，我们发现语义不同的工作记忆对象表现出截然不同的保留和压缩行为。这种异构性启发了基于语义的记忆管理。我们研究了两种语义感知策略：对象感知压缩策略和基于检索的策略。评估结果表明，校准带来的收益可能无法迁移到保留任务上，且相同的token预算并不意味着相同的交付上下文或记忆效果（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 通过分析55个编码智能体轨迹，该研究发现工作记忆中不同语义对象具有截然不同的保留与压缩特性，据此提出了对象感知压缩和基于检索的语义感知记忆管理策略，并指出校准收益未必能迁移到新任务上。
en_tdlr: Analyzing 55 archived coding-agent trajectories, this work shows that semantically distinct working-memory objects exhibit distinct retention and compression behaviors, motivating semantically informed memory management strategies (object-aware compression and retrieval-based policies), while revealing that calibration gains may not transfer to held-out tasks.
